scope: Data-only Mono.Cecil metadata and IL audit of owner-supplied installed server assembly; target assembly not executed

persistentCompatibility.rootRoomAndPlayerSessionFields: All serialized g field names and types present in candidate c; candidate adds GameplayRevision
persistentCompatibility.campaignDifference: Three explicit pending presence/schema fields in g are absent from c; c-only blank normalization does not honor an explicit g false flag
persistentCompatibility.normalizer: For schema>=1 flags=storedFlags AND meaningfulPayload; for schema<1 flags=meaningfulPayload. Null payloads whose flag is false. Normalizer does not change schema. Meaningful means any non-whitespace source/name/mode (plus hero/prompt for reward) or a nonempty revealed-card list.
persistentCompatibility.capture: g Capture sets schema1 and booleans from HasPersistable* predicates and emits payload only while predicate true.
persistentCompatibility.deckPersistable: Payload != null; SourceCardId and Mode non-whitespace; revealed count>0; options count>0; top of encounter deck matches revealed cards ordinal-ignore-case.
persistentCompatibility.rewardPersistable: Payload != null; Mode non-whitespace; reward options count>0.
persistentCompatibility.apply: ApplySaveData normalizes presence before restore and sanitizes pending deck/reward after restoring search/encounter decks using persistable predicates.
persistentCompatibility.saveAndClone: Local TryLoad, authority Clone and server room TryLoad normalize explicit presence. Capture writes schema1.

remotePersistence.gSaveCurrent: Returns true and message before CanSave/filesystem when remote authority owns persistence. Candidate c currently lacks this guard.
remotePersistence.deleteSave: No remote guard in g DeleteSave.

serverLifecycle.loadFailure: Initialize still creates a fresh room after failed TryLoad; no refusal in g
serverLifecycle.constructor: Retains existing RoomId after trim, sets build, preserves player/session data except Connected=false, subscribes state events and immediately persists if safe
serverLifecycle.diagnostics: Snapshot has 4 extra g diagnostic strings: origin, created, updated and persistence path; no extra persistent room/session fields

wire.commandEnumValues: 0 through 36, same named values as candidate c
wire.gRequest: No RoomAccessKey; candidate adds optional field for secured transport
wire.gSnapshot: No GameplayRevision or HeroMovement details; authoritative MovingHeroIds remains available
wire.versionCompatibility: Existing clients verify exact build; forward update needs matching rebuilt client/server and separate original/target health expectations

recommendations: Preserve the 3 g pending schema fields and recovered semantics before migrating existing campaign data.
Retain/add restored-room diagnostics and require restoration proof during activation to avoid silent fresh-room fallback.
Keep new security, ownership, revision, async/background and camera fixes from validated branch.
Use explicit compatibility tests for g schema false flags with stale meaningful payloads, true valid choices, legacy schema0, process restart and reconnect credentials.
Resolve schema-aware behavior for current branch tests that deliberately preserve meaningful partial choices; blindly copying g sanitizers changes that behavior.
limits: This metadata/IL audit does not certify Unity assets, authored content, original platform-conditional sources, gameplay behavior, or production migration.
Large full-fingerprint differences include compiler-generated naming/optimization/attribute noise; changed method fingerprints alone do not prove behavior changes.
